strategy.label: template transfer from the CH unit process of the same product, main amounts calibrated within 0.5-2x
strategy.note: The DE board inventory sits in a confidential annex of the KBOB 2016 report, so the structure of BAFU's own CH unit process (10 inputs) is reused, scaled to 10 kg/m2, with the grid switched to DE. Six main amounts are fitted within bounds; three land on the 2x ceiling, i.e. the German plant is more energy-intensive than the template allows. Hybrid node built on top.

evidence.source: bafu-2026: Gypsum fibre board, at plant [CH] (unit process, 10 inputs)
evidence.note: Same product, Swiss unit process. The DE dataset (treeze/QualiBOB 2016, 'data from German manufacturers') keeps its board-production inventory in a confidential annex, so the CH structure is reused; grid electricity switched to DE; the six main amounts may move within 0.25-4x of the CH value. The DE dataset is per m2; the CH template (per kg) is scaled by 10 kg/m2 (Kasser 2016, D: 10 kg/m2, 12.5 mm). Free amounts bounded to 0.5-2x the scaled template.

evidence.source: 2016 - Renewal and expansion of LCA data in KBOB - Kasser.pdf
evidence.note: 10 kg/m2, 12.5 mm; board inventory confidential (Anhang Z); binder and transport inventories printed.
